name: dsh-mcp-servers
description: MCP server manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Adds a settings section that lists every MCP server registered in the profile, lets you enable/disable, add, edit, delete and restart them, and shows live tool counts reported by the MCP client. Built on the same Typert Remote gateway shape as dsh-addons-manager.

scripts.test: node test/yamlkit.test.mjs && node test/patchops.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/host.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/yamlkit.mjs && node --check lib/patchops.mjs
